transcription.provenance: LLM transcription from the Gallica microfilm images of BnF fr. 16127, glyph by glyph on line strips, one ASCII label per sign (legend in <conventions>); a = round closed a, α/@ = open alpha, split on 21 Sept 2026. No glyph coordinates were kept. The reading of each glyph (r, basis="court") is the letter of the Court's contemporary decipherment (ff. 139-141) that the hard-EM aligner (f1573/align2.py) matched to it; key= gives the same sign's spread over the whole alignment. f. 137v was not transcribed.
transcription.conventions: d plain d (straight or curled back) D barred d (đ) e looped e c a b g h k m n o p q r s t u v x y i(ı) as they look E oe ligature w barred omega W struck w / "ew" ligature O barred o S long-s with crossbar j plain long s P "sp" ligature F phi (looped crossed stem) f barred f C barred C * asterisk-cross # triple bar + dagger z "2"-like 3 "3"-like Z double z A N M V B double loop & ampersand-like ^ lambda @ alpha ll double l X barred b Q hooked S digits 4 10 11 16 17 24 25 30 Added 17 Sept: G looped d (delta form) 9 barred q 23 = the "z3" pair (figure 23?) Z = "zz" (22?) 8 = ampersand/8-like Q3 = hooked S with 3 above / = slash y = n with long descender Split: α = open alpha. "/" = scribe's word gap, "." = dot.
